bullets.text: Around forty students fell ill after a dead lizard was found in the midday meal sambar at a government school in Tiruvallur district.
A six-member gang waylaid a pharmaceutical firm employee and robbed him of twenty-four lakh rupees at knifepoint in Adyar.
The CII Madurai Zone submitted a proposal to Additional Chief Secretary Atul Anand to establish an AI Centre of Excellence in Madurai.
The Greater Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable locations prone to waterlogging and arranged pumps ahead of the northeast monsoon.
Power supply will be suspended in Taramani areas on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM for scheduled maintenance work.
The Greater Chennai Traffic Police extended the operation of special e-challan call centres until October 15 for motorists to settle fines.
Ramancheri residents staged a protest demanding the construction of an overbridge on the national highway.
Police are investigating a private industrial unit near Gummidipoondi for allegedly transporting red soil using fake bills.
Hyderabad could overtake Chennai as India's second-largest data centre market within four years due to land and power constraints.
Starbucks is expanding its Chennai GCC to create around 800 technology roles while restructuring operations across North America.
Nasscom released its second paper under the DPDP Series examining the treatment and public-source use of publicly accessible personal data.
Pe. Shanmugam stated that the POCSO court judge, rather than the TVK government, is responsible for the escalation of the Gem Veermani case.
TVK leader Vijay announced the appointment of eleven former AIADMK ministers who joined the party as deputy general secretaries.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani Phase II metro rail line on October 11.
